|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Han (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “[Pilot] 3, 4: Falcon. If Or Be Destroyed on table, immune to attrition < Han's Power, and Force retrieved with Or Be Destroyed is immune to Secret Plans. While armed with a blaster, Han is defense value +2 and adds 2 to each of his weapon destiny draws.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots (4 if ''Falcon''). While armed with a blaster, Han’s defense value and weapon destiny draws are +2. Force retrieval with Or Be Destroyed is immune to Secret Plans. While Or Be Destroyed on table, immune to attrition < Han’s power.” '''What changed:''' “[Pilot] 3, 4: Falcon. If Or Be Destroyed on table, immune” → “Adds 3”; “attrition < Han's Power,” → “power of anything he pilots (4 if ''Falcon''). While armed with a blaster, Han’s defense value”; added “weapon destiny draws are +2.”; “retrieved” → “retrieval”; “armed with a blaster, Han is defense value +2 and adds 2” → “Or Be Destroyed on table, immune”; “each of his weapon destiny draws.” → “attrition < Han’s power.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 2, slip 11. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Han]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 3: Revolution#Cards|Virtual Set 3: Revolution]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Han (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Han]]. Code OVS3 · GEMP id 1103_11.
